preregistration.frozen_at: before submission; committed to the repository with this script
preregistration.unit: graph seed (15 per harder geometry), paired within seed
primary_endpoints: E1: Heron mean normalized gap < 1 (uniform random sampling) on each harder geometry
E2: Heron execution penalty = Heron mean gap - ideal light-cone p=1 gap, per geometry
E3: sign-invariant label agreement of the lowest-energy Heron sample vs the non-spatial axial two-means rule, paired by seed
secondary_endpoints: lowest-energy Heron sample vs best of an equal number of uniform random samples (agreement and gap)
drift control: curved_90 seeds 2001-2005 vs the published Heron values
preregistration.tests: exact two-sided paired sign-flip tests on seed-level differences; Holm over E3 and the random-sampling comparison within each geometry
